**Build passes now, exit 0.**

Two real bugs, both from the bump.

`resolveRetries` read `options.retries`, but the bundler now sends `retryCount`. It threw `TypeError`. Fixed at [src/core/options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6), old shape still works.

`isBackoffEnabled` threw on an unset flag. The new loader gives `undefined`, not `false`. Fixed at [src/net/retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7), unset means disabled.

The 8 warnings are hardcoded strings in [build.js:18](build.js:18). No such source files exist.

Next: nothing.
